title: Cost per Student by Level
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Calculate the yearly cost per student and the district cost for Level 2, 3, and 4 textbooks from itemized costs, then explore AI usage, token price, and devices.

educational.topic: Total cost of ownership by textbook level
learningObjectives: The learner will calculate the yearly cost per student and the district cost for Level 2, Level 3, and Level 4 textbooks from itemized costs, to within one cent per student, in three of three challenges.
prerequisites: Cost per student, cost modeling, total cost of ownership, and the cost items for each level, from the section "Putting a Cost on Each Level" in Chapter 7.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit three calculations before the controls unlock, then explore the cost structure
keyQuestions: Which items does each level add?
How large is the device share next to the software items?
commonMisconceptions: Software price is the main cost of a digital textbook
A free textbook has no cost
Higher levels always cost far more
assessmentOpportunities: What does Level 3 cost per student per year without a device?
Level 4 at 3.6 million tokens and $2.00 per million?
Is a free textbook free to run?
Is software the main cost of a digital textbook?

controls.name: Your answer box and Check
controls.description: type a dollar amount and press Check (or Enter). Two attempts per challenge; only the first counts.

controls.name: Next
controls.description: moves on; after challenge 3 it unlocks the controls.

controls.name: Tokens per session, Sessions per day, School days
controls.description: sliders for AI usage at Level 4.

controls.name: Device purchased
controls.description: checkbox that adds $75.00 per student per year at every level.

controls.name: Redo challenges and Defaults
controls.description: start the challenges again, or reset the controls.
